verdict.rationale: Column publishes an API reference backed by an OpenAPI spec (live at /openapi.json), and its getting-started guide walks through a payment workflow that can be run against a full sandbox, so examples are executable in practice. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive in-browser reference, such as a 'try it' console or embedded runnable requests. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer, in-docs runnable examples, independent or hands-on confirmation of interactivity.
